run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum number of transformations to make two matrices equal
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix pairs to verify correct transformation count results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating input matrix A during element-wise subtraction
review_f_gold: review f_gold for the consistency check using A[i][j] - A[i][0] - A[0][j] + A[0][0]
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes minimum operations to equalize two matrices via row and column increments
